4.4 stars. 118 reviews. And most tourists walk right past Chùa Sùng Đức without knowing it exists.

This Buddhist temple sits in Khu 1, Phú Quốc, and delivers something the beach clubs cannot: actual quiet. Incense, ornate rooftop details, and zero crowds on a weekday morning.

Add it between beach days. You'll thank yourself later.
